one_liner: Deploy and manage sites, builds, DNS, and serverless functions programmatically.

evidence.claim: Netlify exposes a REST-style JSON API documented via an OpenAPI reference.
evidence.quote: This is a REST-style API that uses JSON for serialization and OAuth 2 for authentication.

evidence.claim: Primary auth is OAuth2; users can register OAuth apps self-serve in user settings.
evidence.quote: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. All requests must use HTTPS.

evidence.claim: Personal access tokens can be generated in the UI and used as Bearer tokens for scripts.
A free plan exists that includes deploy-from-API capability, so credentials are self-serve without payment.
evidence.quote: Deploy from AI, Git, or API Private by default. Start for free

evidence.claim: Netlify ships an official MCP server from its own GitHub org and documents it in its docs.
evidence.quote: Netlify MCP Server follows the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable code agents to use the Netlify API and CLI

notes: Official remote MCP server documented at docs.netlify.com agent setup pages ('Netlify offers an MCP server'); API base is https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/, HTTPS only. Rate limits: 500 req/min generally, deploys 3/min and 100/day; PATs support optional expiration dates; OAuth2 required (not PATs) for public integrations; official Go and JS API clients plus CLI and SDK available.
